title: Corroding Transmission
description: A single metallic hit is shattered into a granular high-register swarm via chop and striate, then squiz-mangled and slowly eaten alive by a crush/coarse/distort degradation arc. Over 16 cycles it morphs from a glittering chrome cloud into a corroded, bit-starved alien signal.
code:
setcpm(124/4)
stack(
  s("metal*4").n("<0 2 1 3>/2")
    .chop("<8 16 24 32>/8").striate("<2 4 3>/4")
    .speed(sine.slow(13).range(1.4, 3.2)).squiz("<1 2 1 4>/4")
    .crush(saw.slow(16).range(16, 4)).coarse("<1 2 4 8>/8")
    .distort(sine.slow(24).range(0, 0.9))
    .hpf(sine.slow(11).range(1200, 4200)).bpf(saw.slow(32).range(2000, 7000)).resonance(14)
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.1, 0.9))
    .sometimesBy(0.18, x => x.speed(-1))
    .off(1/8, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.3).crush(6))
    .delay("0.4:0.333:0.6").room(0.55)
    .gain(0.85)
)
